findings.description: The routing flag of a pair depends on preset declaration order. governing keeps the first preset stating a key (src/prosiform/cli.py:900, above.setdefault), so when an alternative and an ordinary preset, both selected, state one identical pair, the pair is a silent routing pair if the alternative is declared first and warns W_SUBST_USED if the ordinary preset is declared first. Reproduced with work-kind.md declaring epic {choice, subst body.md: epic-body.md} and mock {subst body.md: epic-body.md}, linked with title 'epic, mock': no warning; swapping the declaration order: W_SUBST_USED at work-kind.md:11:1. The design (Link classification, the substitution mapping) reports a pair an ordinary preset states and selects presets with no precedence from order. No criterion's fixture covers an identical pair stated twice, and the outcome is a warning only.
